title: Druid: Yami e no Tsuisekisha
native_title: ドルイド ～闇への追跡者～
overview:
The island world of Navan is ruled by four druid brothers, Lawson, Curak, Havnar and Astor, each devoted to a different element and each governing his own island. When Lawson disappears, his brothers cannot search one another's lands, so they send you, the grandson of a druid, to find him.

This action role-playing game mixes battles against monsters with adventure-style exploration. Talk with the people of Navan, gather and use items to solve puzzles, piece together the history of the druids, and cast spells by combining the four elements of earth, fire, air and water.

- Single-player action RPG with adventure elements
